name: Brand Relationship Spectrum
diagnostic: Where does each product in our portfolio sit on the spectrum between a monolithic Branded House and an independent House of Brands?
artifact: A 4-Model Architectural Continuum Ledger defining Master Brands, Sub-Brands, Endorsed Brands, and House of Brands assets, detailing how equity transfers between products.
trap: Creating an uncoordinated House of Brands architecture at startup scale, fragmenting engineering focus and marketing budgets.
pedigreeFull: David A. Aaker & Erich Joachimsthaler (*Brand Leadership*, 2000).
